errata.error: CCO's list puts West Bay Harbour at 50.7102° N, 2.8200° W, 3.9 km west of the harbour. GESLA's record of the gauge, which CCO supplied, and CMEMS's copy of it both put it at 50.7089° N, 2.7641° W.
errata.response: The station refresh moves it to 50.70888, −2.76411, listed in `POSITIONS` in `src/positions.ts`. If CCO moves the station, the refresh reports the entry and fails the run until a person checks it.

errata.error: CCO's levels hold fill values where a gauge sent nothing, with no flag: 999.9999 or −999.9999, and at some gauges exactly 99.999, −99.999 or −10. A year of Exmouth's has 16 readings of 999.9999 from 18:30 on 18 December 2019, Hastings Pier's 2019 has 2 on 19 June, and Swanage Pier's 2018 has 2 of −999.9999 on 23 April. Deal Pier has 3,249 readings of exactly ±99.999 between April 2012 and August 2020, Brighton 167 of exactly −10 between August 2018 and September 2020, and Arun Platform 1 on 10 February 2014. GESLA's records of CCO's gauges hold such values too, as erratum `gesla-fill-values` says. The store's span of −500 to 9,000 m admits 999.9999, 99.999 and −10, and its QC marks the rest doubtful or bad after the fact.
errata.response: A level of 999 m or more in either direction, or exactly 99.999, −99.999 or −10, is left out as missing, as is 9999. No tide reaches those, and no gauge here reads exactly −10.
errata.evidence: Every stored CCO reading, 13.1 million from 2004 to 2026, read on 2026-11-17: the sentinels above, found by the exact level. 999.9999 and −999.9999 were found in one year of readings at six sites, 2013 to 2020, read from the API on 2026-11-16: Deal Pier 2015, Arun Platform 2012, Brighton 2020, Swanage Pier 2018, Exmouth 2019 and Hastings Pier 2019. The other years of those, and the other sites, weren't scanned from the API.

errata.error: For stretches of 2011 at West Bay Harbour and of 2010 and 2011 at Port Isaac, CCO sends each reading twice, stamped a second apart, as 11:20:02 and 11:20:03, with the same level to within 2 mm. West Bay Harbour has 6,513 such pairs and Port Isaac 4,184, and in all but 8 of them the two levels are within 10 mm. Arun Platform has 11 pairs a second apart in 2012 and 2013, Lymington 5 and Sandown Pier 1, whose levels differ.
errata.response: A reading within 2 seconds of the one before it, with a level within 5 mm of it, is left out, so the first of each pair stays. Pairs whose levels differ are both kept.
errata.evidence: Every stored CCO reading, read on 2026-11-17, compared with the one before it at the same site: West Bay Harbour on 30 March 2011 has 11:20:02 and 11:20:03, 2.081 and 2.080 m, then 11:30:02 and 11:30:03, 2.099 m twice.

errata.error: A request for a window with no readings answers `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":]}`, which isn't JSON. Lymington and Brighton instead answer HTTP 500 for a window before their first reading.
errata.response: The adapter reads the first as no values. The second is an error, so a backfill of those two sites starts at their first year (README, Running ingest).
errata.evidence: Requests of 2026-11-16: Herne Bay for 1 June 2001 answers the first body; Lymington for 1 June 2008 and Brighton for 1 June 2005 answer 500 with `Internal Server Error`.
